title: Git mental model: snapshots, not diffs
body: Commits are snapshots linked by parents. Branches are movable pointers. Practice: git init, commit twice, run git log --graph --oneline.

title: Terminal relay: pipes and redirection
body: Compose small tools: grep | sort | uniq -c. Redirect with > and >>, capture errors with 2>&1. Practice: count the most common words in a file.

title: Rebase vs merge: choosing a history shape
body: Rebase rewrites for linear history; merge preserves context. Never rebase shared branches. Practice: resolve the same conflict both ways.

title: Learning loop: write, break, explain
body: For each concept: write a minimal example, deliberately break it, explain the failure aloud, then teach it back in 3 sentences.

title: Agentic relay: delegating with checkpoints
body: Give agents small tasks, require evidence, and gate irreversible actions behind human approval.
